description: What a table Data Observability watches is built from and what is built from it, before you change it or trust its data: the tables upstream and downstream, several steps each way, that are late, dropped, have open alerts, or whose pipeline failed its last run - nearest first, with how many steps away and the tables between - then the rest, the pipelines that load the upstream tables from outside with their latest run, and the BI dashboards built on it. Pass table: its schema.table key (public.orders), its name alone (orders), or its ID; and depth: the steps each way, 1 to 5 (default 3). A name several databases share answers with each match. Read-only.

depth.description: How many steps each way (default 3, max 5). Ask with more when the answer says the lineage goes on.

table.description: The table: its schema.table key (public.orders), its name alone (orders), or its ID.

name: get_data_table_lineage
title: Get Data Table Lineage
